slots.title: Review image 5 — Copper Peptide Night Cream
slots.prompt: High end beauty campaign photograph, square format, an extremely tight close up of the face of a Latina woman around forty, a professional beauty campaign model with elegant bone structure, a silver streak at her temple and full lips. The crop is very close: her face fills the entire frame edge to edge, the top of her head is cut off by the upper edge and her chin sits near the lower edge. Turned three quarters, her eyes looking off to the side past the camera, expression composed and warm. She is actively applying pale blue cream, colour #A6C4E0 to her face. Two fingertips work the cream in small circles into her cheek, caught mid motion, a soft swirl of un-blended cream on the skin of her cheek around where the fingertips touch. The cream is on her CHEEK ONLY. Her hand is completely clean: no cream on the backs of her fingers, none on the tops of her fingers, none on her knuckles or nails. Product appears only on her face. A genuine application gesture, mid action, not a hand resting decoratively. Luxury beauty campaign finish: luminous dewy glowing complexion, healthy and even, with skin still reading as real rather than airbrushed to plastic. Subtle natural makeup — a softly tinted glossy lip, groomed defined brows, a hint of liner — never heavy or matte. A single delicate fine ring or thin chain may be visible. Behind her a seamless pale neutral grey backdrop, colour #D8D6D4, almost entirely hidden by the closeness of the crop. Soft broad key light from the front with a gentle fill and a clean catchlight. 100mm lens at f4, natural skin tones, clean neutral grade, editorial beauty advertising quality.
